prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity portrait mobile app direction comp, decision-stage north star for SANAD
Primary request: Design a shippable operating mobile Chat screen for SANAD, inspired by a holographic remittance folio: pearlescent security-thread banknotes, bilingual remittance slips, and modern mobile finance. This is product UI, not marketing art.
Scene/backdrop and structure: show only the portrait app viewport, edge-to-edge with no phone hardware and no surrounding scene. Top identity bar with exact bilingual identity "SANAD" and "سند", a small synthetic-demo status, and one crisp binary connection mark. Then a scrollable buyer/supplier conversation. The focal moment is one large linked synthetic olive-oil invoice embedded naturally in the chat: invoice summary, precise amount typography, fee/allocation status, and a clear single bridge action into Finance. Below it, one short reply and a practical message composer. Persistent bottom navigation shows Chat selected and Finance available.
Subject/content: synthetic olive-oil trade invoice shared between fictional participants Bilal and Amira. Use exact primary labels where legibility permits: "SANAD", "سند", "Chat", "Finance", "Synthetic demo", "Olive oil invoice", "Invoice #SAN-1042", "€4,860.00", "Review payment options", "Fee owner: undecided", "Shared", "Not agreed". Small secondary copy may be minimal but must not introduce factual claims.
Style/medium: realistic high-fidelity mobile product UI, refined editorial fintech, operating screen rather than concept art. Milky white paper surfaces with sparse pearlescent security-thread microline details, a controlled lilac security glow, crisp black ink, exact spacing, aligned tabular money figures, bilingual identity handled with dignity.
Composition/framing: portrait device viewport approximately 9:19.5. Strong vertical information hierarchy, generous but efficient padding, compact top bar, readable conversation, invoice occupies the center and is the unmistakable focal moment. The invoice-to-finance bridge is the only saturated large control. Avoid a dashboard grid or card collage.
Lighting/mood: luminous but flat-enough for usable UI; pearlescent effects appear as thin security foil, edge sheen, and one lilac halo, never glossy sci-fi glass.
Color palette: #F7F5FA ground, #DCCBFF lilac security glow, #FFB7E8 pearlescent pink highlight, #93E6DA mint verification accent, #17151B ink.
Materials/textures: milky paper, extremely fine guilloché micro-lines, translucent holographic thread, precise printed remittance-slip rules. Keep textures subordinate to legibility.
Typography: oversized precise financial typography for the invoice total, crisp modern sans-serif for interface labels, tabular numerals, clear Arabic wordmark. Strong black-and-white hierarchy with binary state marks using filled/empty circles, check/x geometry, and explicit text labels.
Text (verbatim): "SANAD", "سند", "Chat", "Finance", "Synthetic demo", "Olive oil invoice", "Invoice #SAN-1042", "€4,860.00", "Review payment options", "Fee owner: undecided", "Shared", "Not agreed".
Constraints: synthetic demo context only; preserve one-purpose Chat screen and a separate Finance destination; show a functional composer and bottom navigation; practical touch targets; no invented claims; no payment completed state; no real provider logos; no legal, identity-verification, Sharia, safety, exchange-rate, payout, or zero-fee claims; no device mockup frame; no poster composition; no watermark.
Avoid: marketing hero art, glassmorphism, neon cyberpunk, cryptocurrency clichés, bento dashboards, ornamental gradients, illegible microtext, fake testimonials, celebratory success badges, photography, 3D device render, extra logos.
